```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
```

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=5}

# Load data
us_trade_balance <- read.csv("../Downloads/us-trade-deficit-by-country-2025.csv")

us_trade_balance <- us_trade_balance |> 
  filter(USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024 > 0) |> 
  select(country, USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024) |> 
  rename(US_Trade_Deficit_2024 = USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024)

global_trade_balance <- read.csv("../Documents/global_trade_balance.csv") 

cleaned_data <- global_trade_balance |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "GTB_Year",
    values_to = "Global_Trade_Balance"
  ) |>
  mutate(GTB_Year = sub("X", "", GTB_Year)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Global_Trade_Balance)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  slice_max(order_by = GTB_Year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(country, GTB_Year, Global_Trade_Balance)

us_import_tariffs <- read.csv("../Downloads/us_import_tariffs.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Tariff = as.numeric(str_replace(Tariff, "%", "")),
  ) |>
  add_row(
    country = "Canada",
    Tariff = 0,
  ) |>
  add_row(
    country = "Mexico",
    Tariff = 0,
  )

# Load and expand GDP
gdp_by_country <- read.csv("../Documents/gdp_by_country.csv") |>
  mutate(
    X2024 = as.numeric(X2024),
    GDP_2024 = X2024 * 1e9
  ) |>
  select(country, GDP_2024)

# Merge
merged_data <- us_trade_balance |>
  inner_join(cleaned_data, by = "country") |>
  left_join(us_import_tariffs, by = "country") |>
  left_join(gdp_by_country, by = "country")

limit <- 15

plot_data <- merged_data |> 
  arrange(desc(US_Trade_Deficit_2024)) |> 
  slice_head(n = limit) |>
  select(country, US_Trade_Surplus = US_Trade_Deficit_2024, Global_Trade_Balance) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(US_Trade_Surplus, Global_Trade_Balance),
    names_to = "Trade_Type",
    values_to = "Balance"
  ) 

# After pivot_longer()
plot_data <- plot_data |> 
  mutate(
    country = factor(country, levels = merged_data |> 
                       arrange(desc(US_Trade_Deficit_2024)) |> 
                       slice_head(n = limit) |> 
                       pull(country))
  )

tariff_line_data <- limited_data |>
  select(country, Tariff) |>
  mutate(country = reorder(country, -Tariff))

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = country, y = Balance, fill = Trade_Type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +

  # Add line + dots for Tariff using second axis
  geom_line(
    data = tariff_line_data,
    aes(x = country, y = Tariff * 1e9, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = tariff_line_data,
    aes(x = country, y = Tariff * 1e9),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10 / 1e-9, color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Trade Type",
  values = c(
    `US_Trade_Surplus` = "#00BFC4",  # blue
    `Global_Trade_Balance` = "#F8766D"  # orange
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Global Trade Balance",
    "US Trade Balance"
  )
) +

  # Axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "B"),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./1e9, name = "Tariff (%)")  # secondary y-axis
    
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Country",
    y = "Trade Balance (Billions USD)",
    fill = "Trade Type",
    
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2e11))

```

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
# Load trade deficit data
us_trade_balance <- read.csv("../Downloads/us-trade-deficit-by-country-2025.csv") |>
  filter(USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024 > 0) |> 
  select(country, USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024) |> 
  rename(US_Trade_Deficit_2024 = USTradeDeficit_TradeDeficit_usd_2024)

# Load global trade balance
global_trade_balance <- read.csv("../Documents/global_trade_balance.csv") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "GTB_Year",
    values_to = "Global_Trade_Balance"
  ) |>
  mutate(GTB_Year = sub("X", "", GTB_Year)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Global_Trade_Balance)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  slice_max(order_by = GTB_Year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(country, GTB_Year, Global_Trade_Balance)

# Load and clean tariffs
us_import_tariffs <- read.csv("../Downloads/us_import_tariffs.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Tariff = as.numeric(str_replace(Tariff, "%", ""))
  ) |>
  add_row(country = "Canada", Tariff = 0) |>
  add_row(country = "Mexico", Tariff = 0)

# Load and expand GDP
gdp_by_country <- read.csv("../Documents/gdp_by_country.csv") |>
  mutate(
    X2024 = as.numeric(X2024),
    GDP_2024 = X2024 * 1e9
  ) |>
  select(country, GDP_2024)

# Merge all data
merged_data <- us_trade_balance |>
  inner_join(global_trade_balance, by = "country") |>
  left_join(us_import_tariffs, by = "country") |>
  left_join(gdp_by_country, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    US_Trade_Surplus_Pct_GDP = US_Trade_Deficit_2024 / GDP_2024 * 100,
    Global_Trade_Balance_Pct_GDP = Global_Trade_Balance / GDP_2024 * 100
  )

# Limit to top N by US trade deficit
limit <- 30
limited_data <- merged_data |>
  arrange(desc(US_Trade_Deficit_2024)) |>
  slice_head(n = limit)

# Prepare plot data
plot_data <- limited_data |> 
  select(
    country, 
    `US_Trade_Surplus (% GDP)` = US_Trade_Surplus_Pct_GDP, 
    `Global_Trade_Balance (% GDP)` = Global_Trade_Balance_Pct_GDP
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`US_Trade_Surplus (% GDP)`, `Global_Trade_Balance (% GDP)`),
    names_to = "Trade_Type",
    values_to = "Balance"
  )

tariff_line_data <- limited_data |>
  select(country, Tariff) |>
  mutate(country = reorder(country, -Tariff))

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(country, -Balance), y = Balance, fill = Trade_Type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +

  geom_line(
  data = tariff_line_data,
  aes(x = country, y = Tariff / 2.857, group = 1),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black",
  size = 1
) +
geom_point(
  data = tariff_line_data,
  aes(x = country, y = Tariff / 2.857),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black",
  size = 2.5
) +

# Primary y-axis for trade balance, secondary y-axis for tariff (0–100%)
scale_y_continuous(
  labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
  sec.axis = sec_axis(~. * 2.857, name = "Tariff (%)", breaks = seq(0, 100, 20))
) +

  labs(
    title = "Trade Balances (% of GDP) and US Tariffs by Country",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Trade Balance (% of GDP)",
    fill = "Trade Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "black")
  )

```
